name: react-native
description: Expo + React Native + TypeScript + Expo Router + TanStack Query + Zustand. Either the cross-platform app itself, or, in a hybrid, the shell that wraps the webview plus the native screens.

notes.platformBoundary: Tokens go in secure storage (expo-secure-store) — AsyncStorage is not encrypted. Background location, push, and camera come paired with native modules and permission declarations (app.json)
notes.shellRole: In a hybrid it is the shell that wraps the webview (react-native-webview). **Web ↔ native bridge messages are a contract** — accept postMessage without verifying the origin and any page loaded in the webview can call native features. The message schema lives in the shared contract package
notes.release: Store review and OTA (EAS Update) split the release path — once a native module changes, it cannot ship over OTA
